about: The one place that says what is current (owner, Nov 11, 2026: "have somewhere as like a master updater or something, to where in the future old things aren't pointing at all different things at all different times"). `current` names the current thing for each kind. `topLevel` has a row for everything at the top of the repository. `records` are files that keep what was said or shipped; they are never rewritten, so the pointer guard does not read them. `replaced` is every path that was replaced or removed, with what stands in its place or the commit it comes back from, kept forever. docs/CURRENT.md is written from this file by `node --import tsx scripts/current/write.ts`; tests/guards/current-pointers.test.ts holds both; `node --import tsx scripts/current/pointers.ts --write` writes the guard's counts.

current.kind: The repository guide every agent follows
The owner's rulings, the only rulings log
Who is running and what each owns
The two-branch plan (work branch and main without test files), the map and the way back
What The Political Process does, mapped to our specs

The engine's state and module registry
The election engine's count of votes
The body engine (every council, board, legislature and Congress)
The daily register (what may run or be kept every day)
The owner's notes as rules for lines
The screen parts, and how to add a screen
The game's server for the play screen
The bust bank (how every person is drawn)
The research data that calibrates the world

topLevel.what: Rules and skills for every agent

The checks that run on pull requests, and the pull request template
A stray screenshot script; the slim-down removes it
The bridge from Claude to the repository guide
The patch notes, written by the release machinery
Written by the calendar browser check; the slim-down moves its output out of the top level
Written by the calendar browser check; the slim-down moves its output out of the top level

The bundler's and test runner's settings
